reader_guide: a11oy.net is the proof registry and canonical RECORD index. a-11-oy.com is the command center. https://a-11-oy.com/verify is the interactive tool that checks a record, not the record itself. Do not merge hosts. Never a11oy.com.

status.meaning: The static evidence surface and its public links are described here; product-runtime readiness is not implied.

edge_security_headers.reason: No source-bound live response-header readback is attached to this candidate. The committed _headers file is policy intent, not deployment evidence.

entrypoints.name: record_index
entrypoints.scope: canonical receipt record on this origin; not an interactive verifier

entrypoints.name: hub_atlas
entrypoints.scope: committed HF snapshot plus GitHub inventory; reachability is not quality

entrypoints.name: governed_console_gateway
entrypoints.scope: static handoff; product runtime state must be observed at a-11-oy.com

entrypoints.name: governed_code_gateway
entrypoints.scope: static handoff; code execution state must be observed at a-11-oy.com

entrypoints.name: static_health_document
entrypoints.scope: committed static JSON; not runtime health, not DSSE-LIVE, not uptime

entrypoints.name: static_reachability
entrypoints.scope: HTML directory route only; GitHub Pages may 301 /readyz to /readyz/; not a JSON health URL

entrypoints.name: receipt_verifier
entrypoints.scope: interactive tool on the product origin; must be observed live; not cloned here

labels.MEASURED: Direct observation with a disclosed source and context.
labels.REPORTED: Public upstream metadata; not independently measured here.
labels.HEURISTIC: A bounded rule or score, not a proof.
labels.UNAVAILABLE: The relevant source could not be inspected.
